issues.title: Some range color changes do not update immediately
Test Sherpa noise suppression with a combined Bluetooth microphone/headphone headset
issues.scope: Speech recognition / Bluetooth capture and playback
issues.baseline: User confirmed Bluetooth audio working on version YMK3W4 after browser echo cancellation was disabled.
test_plan: Use a Bluetooth headset with both microphone and headphones; confirm which microphone is actually captured.
Compare Sherpa recognition with browser noiseSuppression off and on while keeping echoCancellation off.
Verify announcements and chimes remain routed to Bluetooth during recognition, speech playback, Sleep/Wake, and Off/re-enable.
Record actual capture settings, recognition accuracy in background noise, and latency.
issues.note: Noise suppression and echo cancellation are separate settings. Keep the current working defaults until this test is completed.
